populationSource: Fiji Bureau of Statistics 2026 population grid
boundarySource: UNOSAT FJI_Admin_HDX Tikina (86 boundaries); POPGIS / FBOS / PCRAFI attribution
method: Sum positive finite 100m population-grid values by pixel centre within projected Tikina polygons, EPSG:3460. Cells assigned once. No growth factor applied. Rounded per Tikina. Unassigned cells remain outside totals.
